name: Victim Behaviour Inventory
description: Measures a predisposition to different forms of victim behaviour, originally in adolescents. Victim behaviour here means behaviour that makes a person more likely to become the victim of a crime, circumstances or an accident.
instruction: You will see statements about your character, personality, behaviour, particular actions, attitude to people, views on life and so on. If a statement is true for you, answer "Yes"; otherwise answer "No". There are no right or wrong answers, because everyone is right about their own views. Try to answer accurately and honestly. Don't think too long about each question; decide as quickly as you can which of the two answers seems closer to the truth, even if only slightly.

scales.3: Self-harming and self-destructive behaviour (active victim type)
scales.5: Dependent and helpless behaviour (passive victim type)

summaries.Показатели по шкале социальной желательн: Social desirability below the normal range
Social desirability within the normal range
Social desirability above the normal range
summaries.Характерно снижение мотивации достижения: Reduced achievement motivation and spontaneity. May be highly touchy. Good self-control and a desire to follow accepted norms and rules. Stable attitudes, interests and goals.
summaries.Показатели по шкале склонности к агресси: Aggressive victim behaviour within the normal range
summaries.К данной группе относятся испытуемые, ск:
People in this group tend to end up in unpleasant situations that are dangerous to life and health as a result of their own aggression, in the form of attacks or other provocative behaviour (insults, slander, bullying and so on). They deliberately create or provoke conflict. Their behaviour may reflect a typical antisocial orientation in which aggression is directed at particular people in particular situations (selectively), or may be 'diffuse' with no specific target. There is a tendency towards antisocial behaviour and towards violating social norms, rules and ethical values, which the person often disregards. Such people are easily carried away by emotions, especially negative ones, express them vividly, and are dominant, impatient and quick-tempered. Whatever the motives, a violent antisocial attitude is characteristic.
Based on motivation and behaviour, subtypes include the mercenary, the sexually promiscuous, the domestic type (troublemaker, family tyrant), the alcoholic, the negative avenger, the mentally ill person and so on.
summaries.Повышенная забота о собственной безопасн: Heightened concern for one's own safety and a desire to protect oneself from mistakes and trouble. May lead to passivity along the lines of 'better to do nothing than to make a mistake'. Characterized by heightened anxiety, suspiciousness and susceptibility to fears.
summaries.Показатели по шкале склонности к самопов: Self-harming and self-destructive behaviour within the normal range
summaries.Жертвенность, связанная с активным повед: Victimhood linked to active behaviour in which the person provokes the situation through a request or approach. Active victims show two kinds of behaviour: provocative, when another person is drawn in to cause harm, and self-inflicted, marked by a tendency to take risks and act rashly in ways that are often dangerous to themselves and others. They may not realize the consequences of their actions or may not care, hoping everything will be fine. Depending on behaviour and attitude to the consequences, this type includes the conscious instigator (asks for harm to be done to them), the careless instigator (a request or other behaviour objectively provokes the offender, though the victim doesn't fully realize it), the conscious self-harmer (deliberately causes themselves physical or material harm) and the careless self-harmer (harm caused by their own careless actions while committing another offence).
summaries.Характеризуется пассивностью, равнодушие: Characterized by passivity and indifference to what is happening around them. Acts on the principle 'it's none of my business', which may result from resentment towards the outside world or from feeling misunderstood, isolated, unsupported and not part of society.
summaries.Показатели по шкале склонности к гиперсо: Hypersocial behaviour within the normal range
summaries.Жертвенное поведение, социально одобряем: Self-sacrificing behaviour that is socially approved and often expected. This covers people whose positive behaviour draws an aggressor's criminal actions towards them: people who act positively in conflict situations, either always or because of their position or others' expectations. They consider it unacceptable to stay out of a conflict, even if it could cost them their health or life, and are not always aware of the consequences. Brave, decisive, responsive, principled, sincere, kind, demanding, willing to take risks and sometimes overconfident. Intolerant of behaviour that disturbs public order. Self-esteem is usually inflated. Their behaviour has positive motives.
summaries.Склонность к независимости, обособленнос: A tendency towards independence and detachment. Always wants to stand out from the group, has their own view on everything, may be intolerant of other opinions, authoritarian and prone to conflict. Heightened scepticism. There may be inner vulnerability that drives a strong desire to keep apart from others.
summaries.Показатели по шкале склонности к зависим: Dependent and helpless behaviour within the normal range
summaries.Лица, не оказывающие сопротивления, прот: People who do not resist or oppose an offender for various reasons: age, physical weakness, a helpless state (permanent or temporary), cowardice, fear of responsibility for their own unlawful or immoral actions and so on. May have a mindset of helplessness and be unwilling to do things without others' help. May have low self-esteem. Keep getting drawn into crises to gain sympathy and support. Take on the role of the victim. Timid, modest, highly suggestible and conformist. Learned helplessness after repeated exposure to violence is also possible. Tends towards dependent behaviour, is compliant, justifies others' aggression and tends to forgive everyone.
summaries.Вдумчивость, осторожность, стремление пр: Thoughtfulness, caution and a desire to anticipate the possible consequences of one's actions, which sometimes lead to passivity and fears. Self-fulfilment is considerably harder in this case; social passivity may develop, leading to dissatisfaction with one's achievements, frustration and envy.
summaries.Показатели по шкале склонности к некрити: Uncritical behaviour within the normal range
summaries.К данной группе относятся лица, демонстр: This group includes people who act imprudently and cannot assess situations correctly. A lack of critical judgement may stem from negative personal traits (greed, self-interest and so on), from positive ones (generosity, kindness, responsiveness, courage and so on), or from a low intellectual level. They act carelessly and imprudently and misjudge situations because of personal or situational factors such as emotional state, age, intelligence or illness. The uncritical type tends to drink, is indiscriminate in choosing acquaintances, trusting and frivolous. Their moral foundations are weak, made worse by a lack of personal experience or by ignoring it. They tend to idealize people, justify others' negative behaviour and fail to notice danger.
summaries.Очевидно, что испытуемый нечасто попадае: The person evidently rarely gets into critical situations, or has already developed a protective way of behaving that helps them avoid danger. However, an inner readiness for victim behaviour is present. Feeling inner tension, the person most likely tries to avoid conflict altogether.
summaries.Показатели по шкале реализованной виктим: Realized victimization within the normal range
summaries.Испытуемый достаточно часто попадает в н: The person quite often gets into unpleasant or even dangerous situations. The cause is an inner predisposition and readiness to act in certain ways that dominate their individual profile, most often a tendency towards aggressive, rash and spontaneous action.
